# Arsenii Samoilov — arsenii.com

> Senior Technical Program Manager and Engineering PM with 19+ years at Intuit, Atlassian, Adobe, Salesforce, Roku, and Apple. Expert in AI program management, compliance governance, and enterprise delivery. Based in the Bay Area.

## Who is Arsenii Samoilov?

Arsenii Samoilov is a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) and Engineering Program Manager with over 19 years of experience leading enterprise programs at top technology companies. He has driven $50M+ in revenue through AI-enabled growth and monetization strategies, scaled funded accounts 4x, and led C-level programs across product, engineering, compliance, and GTM.

## Key Expertise

- Technical Program Management (TPM)
- Engineering Program Management
- AI Program Management and AI feature adoption
- Compliance Governance and regulatory programs
- Enterprise Monetization Strategy
- Agile and cross-functional program delivery
- Portfolio management at scale
